note: Durable provenance for the crashed-session canary. The raw evidence in V8B1_CANARY_RESULTS.json is NOT overwritten; this file records the operational/accounting interpretation of that same evidence. All three fixtures are classified T2_INFRASTRUCTURE_ONLY per the authorized decision and are EXCLUDED from the primary V8B.1 target sample; this exclusion does not propagate to any other fixture and does not alter the global taint taxonomy.
root_cause: Per-Converse-call SDK read_timeout=90s in runner._bedrock_client is below the observed latency tail of a heavy Sonnet-4.6 call (extended thinking enabled, temperature 1.0). The working single-call golden_v3 baseline for the same model/maxTokens (no thinking) already had median 55.8s and max 118.8s per call; the runner's per-turn calls are strictly heavier and it makes up to MAX_TOOL_TURNS=12 such calls per fixture. Each fixture failed mid-loop at a turn (not on connect) with 'Read timeout on endpoint URL .../converse'.

requests.call_state_reason: A read timeout was observed on the converse endpoint. A read timeout alone does not prove the request was not transmitted or not processed server-side; per policy this is UNKNOWN_AFTER_SEND, not NOT_SENT. No direct AWS evidence (request id / server-side log) is available to prove non-transmission.

accounting.recorded_usage_reason: the timing-out turn raised before usage was folded into the returned manifest; prior-turn usage was accumulated in-process but not persisted on the early-return path
accounting.billing_conservatively: assume up to 6 Converse turns may have incurred cost (thinking + partial output), each possibly billed even though the final turn timed out client-side; treat as non-zero, unbounded-above-by-turn-count, and NOT part of the experiment's scientific spend

requests.call_state_reason: read timeout on converse endpoint; insufficient to declare NOT_SENT; no AWS request-id evidence available.

accounting.recorded_usage_reason: same early-return path as above discarded final-turn usage
accounting.billing_conservatively: assume up to 11 Converse turns may have incurred cost; treat as non-zero and NOT part of scientific spend

requests.call_state_reason: read timeout on converse endpoint; insufficient to declare NOT_SENT; no AWS request-id evidence available.

accounting.recorded_usage_reason: same early-return path as above discarded final-turn usage
accounting.billing_conservatively: assume up to 8 Converse turns may have incurred cost; treat as non-zero and NOT part of scientific spend

aggregate_accounting.spend_interpretation: Non-zero, conservatively accounted: three fixtures each attempted multiple Converse turns (6, 11, 8) before a client-side read timeout. Per-turn usage was not persisted, so exact tokens/cost are UNKNOWN and are accounted conservatively as possibly-billed. None of this is experiment/research spend and none of it produced a research selection or exposed a target outcome.

taint_decision_applied.exclusion_scope: these three fixtures only; not propagated; global taint taxonomy unchanged
